modal.title: Campaign & traffic currency
modal.introFx: EUR, GBP, TRY, RUB rates are loaded from the server (Frankfurter / ECB). Integration currency is set with the “Currency” button in the integrations list.

iso.hint: Pick an ISO currency code. You can filter the list.

marketingChannelBlocks.allUnattributedHidden: All rows are hidden: only records without an integration channel remain. Clear the filter below or set dataSource on import.
marketingChannelBlocks.unknownExplain: Rows without a data source in CRM: often imports from n8n/analytics without an integration tag. Impressions and spend here may overlap Meta/Google session slices without UTMs—do not add them to neighbors as “more ads.”

marketingChannelAnalytics.mapHintGa4: Country comes from countryId when syncing GA4. Intensity by sessions. These are web analytics aggregates, not individual CRM contacts.
marketingChannelAnalytics.mapEmptyNoInfer: No geo in the database for the period and country could not be inferred from campaign names. For GA4 channels, sync the integration after updating.
marketingChannelAnalytics.emptySeries: No daily data for the selected filter.
marketingChannelAnalytics.geoTableHint: Like the Geo report in Google Analytics: sessions and views by country. No individual CRM users—web analytics aggregates only.
marketingChannelAnalytics.fullTableHint: Sort by column. Data matches the period aggregate on the traffic page.
marketingChannelAnalytics.mapHint: Colored by sessions. Country is guessed from keywords in campaign names (e.g. “Almanya”, “Polonya”). Without a match, data does not appear on the map.
marketingChannelAnalytics.mapEmpty: No rows linked to a country from campaign names.
marketingChannelAnalytics.mapNoCountryData: No data for this country in the current selection.
marketingChannelAnalytics.roadmapBody: Geo by session for GA4 channels is pulled on sync (countryId). Reports by page URL, cities, and funnel steps are planned after schema/import extensions.
